=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- Requirement: The review-blocked judge (PR comment entry[12], id 6011321532) required "replace the failed-protection/pinning/verification guide-and-paste fallback with a hard stop: record the blocked gate and give only a corrective verification step, never a Worker deploy command, until the protected default-branch SHA, clean pinned worktree, and pre-deploy checks can be verified." The judge-fix commit e54f23b claimed to apply this fix.
  Expected change site: The "Deploy only a verified, immutable default-branch commit" bullet in the "## Cloudflare Steps" section of .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md (line 94) and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md (line 103) — specifically the trailing sentence "If protection, pinning or verification fails, do not self-execute: explain once and fall back to guide-and-paste for that step."
  Evidence of absence: Both copies still contain the sentence verbatim at those lines. The last run diff changed only the "Limit deploy credential exposure" bullet (lines 97/106) and supporting prose in README.md, changelog.d/6435-prompt-audit-claude-config.md, and the test. No diff hunk removed or rewrote the fallback sentence. The test file tests/test_deploy_activate_command.py has no assertion forbidding "fall back to guide-and-paste" in the Cloudflare section, so a future regression would not be caught by CI. Additionally, changelog.d/6469-deploy-activate-credential-free-checks.md line 6 still says "if commit protection cannot be verified, the command will guide you through the step rather than deploying itself," which describes the bypass as intended behavior rather than a blocked gate.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- File: .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md
  Line or code reference: line 94, sentence "If protection, pinning or verification fails, do not self-execute: explain once and fall back to guide-and-paste for that step."
  Problem: The bullet instructs the agent to hand the operator the manual `wrangler`/`curl` deploy commands even when the protected-default-branch, SHA-pinning, and clean-worktree preconditions cannot be confirmed. A failed safety check becomes an implicit endorsement of the deploy. CLAUDE.md §24.C requires a verified default-branch commit and forbids executing unmerged code with credentials; the guide-and-paste path bypasses both.
  Why it fails at runtime: An agent following the sentence will, after the gate fails, emit the deploy commands for the operator to run. The operator sees real deploy commands and may proceed without independently re-verifying the protection, pinning, and worktree cleanliness that the gate just failed to confirm — converting a failed precondition into an out-of-band bypass of the §24.C boundary.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md
  Line or code reference: line 103, identical trailing sentence
  Problem: Same bypass in the consumer template; a downstream repo's operator can be handed deploy commands after the §24.C preconditions failed.
  Why it fails at runtime: Same as above; consumer repos are the primary deploy-activate audience and inherit the bypass.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md
  Line or code reference: line 101, "No credential → fall back to guide-and-paste" bullet
  Problem: The missing-credential fallback emits exact `wrangler`/`curl` commands without requiring the §24.C preconditions to be verified first. A no-credential session and a failed-precondition session look identical to the operator, but only one was supposed to be allowed past the gate.
  Why it fails at runtime: An operator on a consumer repo with no Cloudflar
